startup_sequence.description: Resolve safe canonical account_id, device_installation_id and state-store identity: existing installations use accepted local/Core installation state; only absence of accepted installation identity permits a pre-existing external provisioning handoff. Mode is derived, never caller-selected, and identity resolution grants no device trust.
Atomically acquire the local process lock for that DeviceInstallation/state-store identity.
If the lock is busy, do not open mutable state store, do not create RuntimeSession, do not initialize adapters, and return information about the existing Core.
After owning the lock, create the RuntimeSession.
Open the mutable state store only after the process lock is held.
After process-lock ownership, RuntimeSession creation, state-store open and integrity verification, derive SETUP_REQUIRED or another readiness state from accepted Core/product state.

Only for derived SETUP_REQUIRED, validate exact pre-existing external product provisioning membership; missing or invalid authority remains fail-closed and starts no private exchange, strategy or order side effect.
A valid one-shot bootstrap authority enables only the later M0.10 initial-security establishment transition; it does not set READY or establish factors in M0.3.
Read durable kill switch state and last trading environment.
Load configuration and secure-store references without putting secrets in command line.
Connect accounts as allowed by readiness gates, perform reconciliation, and acquire required ExecutionLease records.
Enter READY only after startup readiness, reconciliation, authorization, lease, kill-switch and capability/policy gates pass.
DesktopShell opens only by user preference, setup need, or request.

lifecycle applicability is determined by exactly one matching state_case, while final intent executability requires all global role, authentication, authorization, trigger and Core gates
Core IPC REACHABLE requires CORE_HANDSHAKE and CONFIRMED_CURRENT
CORE_HANDSHAKE with Core IPC UNREACHABLE is invalid
Core-mutating commands use only REACHABLE CORE_HANDSHAKE CONFIRMED_CURRENT state cases
ordinary CLOSE_DESKTOP_SHELL cannot close a pending restart without a confirmed running TrayAgent
provisioned DeviceInstallation identity is distinct from M0.10 TRUSTED security designation
RuntimeSession may exist while startup readiness is SETUP_REQUIRED
external product provisioning boundary is the only first-run bootstrap issuer; Bootstrapper and CoreHost cannot self-issue
valid first-run bootstrap authority does not set READY
first-run bootstrap authority cannot authorize normal privileged operations or LIVE
legacy_conflicts: Existing Desktop RuntimeService lives inside GUI process and conflicts with future CoreHost ownership
UiGrpcBridge name can be misleading; it is not currently an interprocess Core transport proof
Legacy daemon/gRPC architecture documents are source material only
Tray/background/autostart are not complete implementation in current baseline
unresolved_questions: Exact open-order shutdown policies in M0.5/M0.9/M0.10
M0.9 operator authorization UX and command risk levels
Future Windows Service secure store, identity and ACL contract

start_core_on_logon.description: Start Core on Windows logon only after setup wizard completion.

valid_core_lifecycle_pairs.description: Core process is not started and has no supervised restart pending.
Normal user/session startup is in progress.
Supervisor is actively starting Core after a crash.
Core is healthy with no restart pending.
Core is degraded but running with no restart pending.
Core is stopping under normal lifecycle.
Core is stopped with no restart pending.
Core has crashed and no restart has been scheduled yet.
Core has crashed and restart is scheduled after backoff.
Core has crashed and restart attempts are exhausted; operator action is required.

state_predicates.description: Independent process-lock/descriptor proof confirms no active runtime; cached STOPPED alone is insufficient when reachability is UNREACHABLE.
Core runtime is known to be active.
Runtime activity is unknown, typically after IPC loss or stale observation.
TrayAgent process is confirmed running and able to present status.
Supervisor has scheduled or is performing a Core restart.
Observed Core state may be stale and cannot be used as current truth.
Validated independent observation proof: PID, start_nonce, source freshness, DeviceInstallation identity, and state-store identity all match.

intent_evaluation_rules: state_case determines lifecycle applicability, not full permission to execute
allowed true does not bypass client role validation
allowed true does not bypass operator authentication
allowed true does not bypass authorization context
zero or multiple matching state_cases means reject
UI success is shown only after Core acknowledgement

invalid_combinations.reason: Stopped, not-started and crashed Core do not have a confirmed reachable Core IPC endpoint.
Cached snapshot cannot provide CONFIRMED_CURRENT after IPC loss.

intent_evaluation_routes.description: Local DesktopShell/Tray lifecycle action; validates trigger/client role, uses intent-specific auth only, records local audit, and does not submit a Core command unless later contract explicitly adds one.
Versioned command to reachable Core; requires role, operator authentication, authorization context, Core IPC, Core revalidation, acknowledgement and audit.
Trusted OS event; no client role/operator auth/command auth required; Core notification/checkpoint is best-effort only if Core IPC is available; result is audited.
Bootstrapper stage after Core-issued MaintenanceAuthorization; cannot bypass prior operator/Core authorization.

first_run_bootstrap_authority_contract.nature: ephemeral protected security/provisioning handoff; not a durable M0.2 entity

acceptance_authority.required: claim fingerprint resolves through a pre-existing Core-visible accepted provisioning membership registry established independently before caller claim validation
acceptance_authority.hash_semantics: integrity only; recomputed self-hash cannot create membership
acceptance_authority.nominal_type_semantics: dataclass, JSON shape, owner string or state fingerprint alone is not authority

required_absence: accepted/current first OperatorIdentity for bootstrap scope
eligibility.time_rule: canonical UTC issued_at_utc <= now_utc <= expires_at_utc and expires_at_utc > issued_at_utc

one_shot_transition.input: accepted provisioning membership plus exact current PRE_INITIAL_SECURITY Core state and SETUP_REQUIRED
one_shot_transition.output: BootstrapTransitionResult with INITIAL_SECURITY_ESTABLISHMENT_AUTHORIZED and INITIAL_SECURITY_ESTABLISHMENT_ONLY purpose plus atomically derived post-state consumption
one_shot_transition.semantic_atomicity: compare current state, authorize and append exact consumed binding as one semantic transition; at most one success per accepted claim

terminal_fencing.one_shot_rule: exact consumed binding or terminal completed lifecycle denies reuse

audit_boundary.uses: canonical M0.2 AuditEvent; M0.7 causation/correlation when available
audit_boundary.ordering: RuntimeSession is created after process-lock ownership and may exist before bootstrap validation; no artificial pre-RuntimeSession event requirement

milestone_ownership.M0.3: pre-existing provisioning authority handoff, startup ordering and one-shot scope
milestone_ownership.M0.10: first OperatorIdentity acceptance, initial TRUSTED designation, PIN verifier, optional platform biometric semantics and first Core-issued authentication proof
milestone_ownership.M0.11: durably atomic compare-and-consume, persistence, migrations, backup and crash recovery for accepted/current membership and consumed facts

invariants: DeviceInstallation identity is not M0.10 TRUSTED designation
Bootstrapper transports but never issues or accepts authority
CoreHost consumes but cannot self-issue provisioning membership
valid bootstrap does not mean READY
current LIVE remains denied
no caller boolean or self-hash authority

startup_identity_resolution.mode_source: accepted/current installation state; never caller first_run boolean
startup_identity_resolution.EXISTING_INSTALLATION: resolve canonical account_id, device_installation_id and state-store identity from accepted local/Core state under later persistence boundary; first-run provisioning handoff not required again
startup_identity_resolution.FIRST_INSTALLATION: only when accepted installation identity is absent, external product provisioning handoff supplies canonical account_id and device_installation_id for state-store/process-lock scope and later setup

core_current_state_authority.acceptance: opaque state reference must resolve in pre-existing Core-owned accepted registry and be the exact current designation for account/device scope
core_current_state_authority.future_m010_fence: accepting first OperatorIdentity must replace current PRE_INITIAL_SECURITY/ABSENT designation; historical PRE may remain audit-only

consumer_revalidation: exact accepted historical PRE registry key/internal/recomputed fingerprint
exact accepted and current POST registry key/internal/recomputed fingerprint
exact PRE to POST single-consumption transition
transition_result_authority.consumed_history_validation: every entry fully validates canonical IDs, positive non-bool generation/revision, lowercase SHA-256, state scope, uniqueness and generation uniqueness

restore_freshness_authority_contract.nature: protected persistent external StateStore freshness fence; implementation-neutral and outside every restorable artifact

scope.bindings: canonical account_id and device_installation_id plus SHA-256 fingerprint derived from the canonical M0.3-resolved state-store identity; never an arbitrary caller path

protected_state_projection.generation_rule: when present, positive non-bool integer; generation 0 is never authority

exact_lifecycle_field_presence.dangling_optional_fields: semantic class MALFORMED_PROTECTED_AUTHORITY; fail closed through existing controlled M0.3 denial/no-READY outcomes

location.platform_requirement: future implementation must provide a conforming mechanism; otherwise authoritative restore fails closed

compare_and_advance.coverage: after genesis, every authoritative StateStore semantic transaction participates; no caller boolean classification
compare_and_advance.next_generation: exact committed_generation + 1; no skip and no rollback

requires: expected committed generation equals protected current
expected committed state fingerprint equals protected current
prepare_protocol.effect: creates exact protected pending membership; PREPARED is not committed/current StateStore authority

idempotent_retry.GENESIS: exact same pending candidate accepted only with expected_generation and expected_state_fingerprint both absent
idempotent_retry.NORMAL: exact same pending candidate accepted only with expected generation/fingerprint equal protected committed current

requirements: do not acknowledge success before required durability point

finalize_protocol.requires: opaque local evidence reference resolves exact accepted current DURABLE_COMMITTED evidence whose scope, generation, state fingerprint and transaction fingerprint equal existing protected PREPARED membership
effect: committed state fingerprint becomes prepared state fingerprint
previous generation can never regain current authority

protected_abort_protocol.transition: PREPARED over COMMITTED G -> COMMITTED G with pending terminally cleared
requires: existing protected PREPARED G+1 over COMMITTED G
opaque reference to accepted current DURABLE_COMMITTED local observation of exact committed G and committed state fingerprint
no accepted current durable observation of candidate G+1

B_after_prepare_before_local_commit.outcome: accepted current durable observation of exact committed G permits executable protected ABORT; pending clears and committed remains G

C_after_local_commit_before_finalize.store: exact G+1 matching state and transaction fingerprints
C_after_local_commit_before_finalize.outcome: accepted current DURABLE_COMMITTED evidence exact-matching protected pending permits FINALIZE

I_GENESIS_AFTER_PREPARE_BEFORE_LOCAL_COM.outcome: GENESIS_PENDING_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; no READY; pending retained; ordinary abort denied; different candidate denied

J_GENESIS_AFTER_LOCAL_COMMIT_BEFORE_FINA.local_durable_evidence: accepted/current exact DURABLE_COMMITTED generation 1 matching state and transaction

K_GENESIS_LOCAL_MISMATCH.outcome: FAIL_CLOSED; no finalize; no ordinary abort to UNINITIALIZED; trusted external recovery required

backup_rollback.history_import: M0.11 responsibility; authority promotion remains denied

startup_restore_consumer_rules.freshness_check: subordinate to StateStore integrity, first initialized recovery gate, and prerequisite to readiness; no mutable store before process lock
startup_restore_consumer_rules.READY_requires: available, valid, exact-scope protected authority and successful freshness reconciliation

failure_outcomes.authority_missing_or_unavailable: fail closed; no READY/current authority; backup cannot reconstruct, select or mint authority

scope_membership_lifecycle.MISSING: no protected scope membership; no READY or self-provisioning; trusted external provisioning/recovery required
scope_membership_lifecycle.UNINITIALIZED: protected exact-scope membership exists; committed generation and fingerprint are absent; no StateStore authority and no READY
scope_membership_lifecycle.PREPARED: protected pending membership exists; candidate is not current authority
scope_membership_lifecycle.COMMITTED: positive committed generation and exact state fingerprint are current freshness authority

genesis_protocol.transition: UNINITIALIZED -> PREPARED generation 1 -> accepted current DURABLE_COMMITTED local evidence -> COMMITTED generation 1
genesis_protocol.finalize_requires: accepted current M0.11-owned durable local evidence exact-bound to protected PREPARED generation 1
genesis_protocol.missing_local_evidence: GENESIS_PENDING_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; no READY; retain exact pending; no different generation-1 candidate; no transition to UNINITIALIZED
genesis_protocol.exact_local_evidence: FINALIZE_MATCHING_PENDING then legal FINALIZE to COMMITTED 1
genesis_protocol.mismatching_local_evidence: FAIL_CLOSED; retain pending; no finalize or ordinary abort; trusted external recovery required
genesis_protocol.future_pending_clear: requires separate protected external recovery authority; absence of local evidence is not proof that durable generation 1 never existed

local_durable_evidence_handoff.owner: M0.11 local durable StateStore observation boundary
local_durable_evidence_handoff.nature: implementation-neutral trusted evidence of the required local durability point; not M0.2 entity, external authority, or membership minter
local_durable_evidence_handoff.acceptance: opaque reference resolves exact accepted and current membership in a private Core/M0.11-owned durable-observation registry

protected_current_designation.accepted_registry_semantics: opaque references may retain protected historical records; acceptance and valid content fingerprint do not imply current authority
authority_critical_resolution_requires: opaque reference exists in protected accepted registry
record is structurally and semantically valid
reference equals exact protected current designation for record scope
transitions_preserve_same_current_refere: COMMITTED G -> PREPARED G+1 -> COMMITTED G+1

trusted_external_replacement.PREPARED: DENIED until legally FINALIZED or, where allowed, normally ABORTED
trusted_external_replacement.authority_revision: membership-local revision may advance for rotation but cannot weaken freshness projection
trusted_external_replacement.consumer_content_parameters: none; only exact current old opaque reference is accepted by the private external-boundary model
trusted_external_replacement.semantic_atomicity: PRE: exact current non-retired stable OLD; POST: OLD terminal RETIRED, NEW accepted and sole current, exact freshness projection preserved; torn or corrupt observation fails closed

protected_current_designation.designation_mapping_location: scope -> current protected reference is protected state inside EXTERNAL_PRODUCT_PROTECTED_STATE_BOUNDARY; outside StateStore, BackupEnvelope, user config, Core registry authority and M0.11 mutable state

operations.INITIAL_EXTERNAL_SCOPE_MEMBERSHIP_PROVIS: only when no current membership exists; establishes exact-scope UNINITIALIZED membership, never magic committed generation
operations.NORMAL_FRESHNESS_ADVANCE: only COMMITTED G -> PREPARED G+1 -> accepted current durable local G+1 -> FINALIZE -> COMMITTED G+1
operations.PROTECTED_REFERENCE_REPLACEMENT: changes opaque reference identity only; exact freshness projection is copied and unchanged

protected_current_designation.retirement_state_location: protected external boundary only; outside StateStore, BackupEnvelope, Core/M0.11 mutable state and user config
protected_current_designation.no_anchor_recursion: conforming protected boundary supplies designation plus terminal retirement; no further anchor layer selected
